mapper.sql: select u.id, u.username, u.nickname, u.role_code as roleCode, u.status, u.email, u.phone, u.max_concurrent_requests as maxConcurrentRequests, u.max_concurrent_streams as maxConcurrentStreams, u.last_login_at as lastLoginAt, u.created_at as createdAt, coalesce(w.balance, 0) as balance from users u left join wallets w on w.user_id = u.id
mapper.select: where u.deleted = 0 order by u.id desc
